 The Paint Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading all maintenance, reliability, robotics, automation, and utility activities within the paint shop. The role ensures maximum equipment availability, optimal paint quality, environmental compliance, and safe operations across pretreatment, e-coat, powder coating, liquid paint, and curing processes. The position requires extensive experience with robotic paint application systems and automated paint shop technologies. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Maintenance Reliability Leadership

Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance programs. Establish maintenance KPIs and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure paint shop equipment availability exceeds business targets. Minimize downtime through proactive maintenance planning and root cause elimination. 
 
 Robotics Automation Management

Coordinate robot calibration, TCP validation, and path optimization. Support robotic cycle-time improvements and paint transfer efficiency projects. 
 
 Paint Shop Equipment Maintenance 
 Responsible for maintenance of: Pretreatment systems Phosphating systems E-Coat systems Powder coating equipment Paint circulation systems Spray booths Paint kitchen systems Ovens and curing equipment Conveyors and skids Lift systems and hoists Air handling units (AHU) Exhaust and filtration systems Pumps, valves, piping systems Compressed air systems Water treatment plants (WTP) Effluent treatment plants (ETP) Fire protection systems 
 
 Controls Electrical Systems 
 Maintain PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems. Troubleshoot automated paint process controls. Ensure integrity of industrial networks and communication systems. Support Industry 4.0 initiatives and smart manufacturing projects. Manage system backups and cybersecurity compliance for automation equipment. 
 
 Reliability Continuous Improvement

Utilize predictive maintenance technologies: Vibration Analysis Thermography Ultrasound Inspection Oil Analysis Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). Lead maintenance cost reduction initiatives. 
 
 Safety, Environmental Regulatory Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with all EHS regulations. Maintain safe operation of paint systems involving flammable materials. Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures. Ensure compliance with VOC emission standards and environmental regulations. Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and hazard analyses. Support ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 compliance requirements. 
 
 Capital Projects Plant Expansion 
 Lead installation and commissioning of paint robots and automation systems. Support greenfield and brownfield paint shop projects. Manage equipment upgrades and modernization programs. Coordinate with OEMs, integrators, suppliers, and contractors. Ensure maintainability requirements are incorporated into new equipment specifications. 
 
 Budget Asset Management 
 Prepare and manage annual maintenance budgets. Control maintenance costs while maintaining reliability targets. Optimize spare parts inventory, including critical robot spare components. Manage vendor contracts and service agreements. Develop long-term asset replacement strategies. 
 
 Team Leadership Development 
 Lead a multidisciplinary team of: Mechanical Engineers Electrical Engineers Automation Engineers Robotics Engineers Supervisors and Technicians Develop technical training programs focused on robotics and automation. Build succession plans and technical competency matrices. Drive a high-performance, accountable maintenance culture. 
 
 Educational Qualifications
